Original street, actors, path and gate canvas actually render

Synthesized sound preference toggles with persisted state
Expanded log exposes stage, windup, actual hit, heal and escort events
Actual dodge cancels a pending own attack; held/repeat K pays exactly once

Blur handler releases held movement and freezes battle without backlog
Malformed storage safely falls back to original setup
Forged combat snapshot fields cannot grant position/health/cart/supplies
Denied storage still supports complete ordinary first street
Full normal first street through keyboard depth/horizontal movement and combo controls
320/360/390/768/1024/1440 widths and help/result controls fit without overflow
Native simultaneous move/action touch points trigger directional dodge and full normal first-street victory
